title: feat(knowledge): knowledge-pgvector, an open vector store on PostgreSQL, and the index fingerprint (#37100)
body:
Fixes #37100

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 自建部署的知识库可以直接用自己的 PostgreSQL（装 pgvector 扩展）存向量做检索，不再需要另外的向量服务；换了嵌入模型或切分方式后，旧索引会被明确拒绝并提示重建，而不是悄悄返回混杂的结果。
- 属于「知识检索」专题，补上开源向量库这一块，并为后续的新代际重建和其他存储打好统一的指纹规则。
- 数据库没装扩展或没权限时，系统照常启动，知识源返回「暂不可用」并给出要执行的 SQL；新包默认不启用，撤回只需不注册该插件。
- 本 PR 改了 CI 工作流文件，需要你批准；另有一个接口放置问题请在评审时一并定夺（见英文部分 Open question）。

## What changes

**New package `@objectstack/knowledge-pgvector`** (Apache-2.0) — `KnowledgePgvectorPlugin` registers `PgvectorKnowledgeAdapter` (id `pgvector`).

- Storage in its own schema `os_knowledge` (option `schema`): `knowledge_generation` (source_id, generation, fingerprint, recipe_hash, dim, model, state, created_at) and one passage table per width, `knowledge_vec_dWIDTH` (source_id, generation, chunk_id, document_id, source_record_id, organization_id, content, title, heading_path, doc_hash, chunk_hash, metadata jsonb, embedding vector(WIDTH)). Object tables live in the connection's `current_schema()`, and the driver's introspection / `os migrate plan` read only that schema, so these tables can neither collide with an object table nor be reported as drift.
- Database: the `url` option, else `OS_DATABASE_URL` / legacy `DATABASE_URL` when it is `postgres://`; its own `pg.Pool` (`poolMax`, default 4). Every embed runs before a connection is checked out for the write. With per-organization databases the store is still the one database the plugin connects to; isolation is the `organization_id` column, filtered in SQL.
- Not ready (no `vector` extension and no right to create it, or no right to create the schema): nothing is created past the failing step, the plugin still registers, boot continues, the warning carries the SQL, `healthCheck` answers `ok: false`, every call answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with the SQL; the next call retries (no restart).
- Search: exact cosine scan via the extension's own schema-qualified cosine-distance operator and `vector` type (no HNSW, so 3072 dims work); organization filter and metadata-equality `filter` in the same `WHERE`, before `ORDER BY distance LIMIT topK`; a passage with cosine similarity not above 0 is not a hit. `queryPrefix` option is prepended to queries only.
- Writes: takes the service's chunks (`capabilities.chunks`); `chunk_hash` per passage; an unchanged passage is not re-embedded (row metadata rewritten); stale chunks of a document deleted in the same transaction.
- `listDocuments` on the write-target generation, byte order (`COLLATE "C"`) for both the order and the cursor.
- Fingerprint: a write or search under another fingerprint, or with an embedder of another width, is refused `409 KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED`; `beginBuild` under the stored fingerprint is a no-op, under another it is refused with the SQL that clears the source (second-generation builds are #37101); `completeBuild` records the recipe hash; `indexStatus` reads both back.
- README: options, database/schema, setup SQL, HNSW as an operator step with the 2,000-dimension limit, rebuilds, and that stored text is as sensitive as the record and is in backups.

**K8 item 8 (ADR-0161 K7), whole, as the Execution note asks**

- `@objectstack/service-knowledge`: `computeIndexFingerprint` (model, variant, dimensions from the adapter's `embedding` descriptor; resolved split + `SPLIT_ALGORITHM_VERSION`; content recipe + `ASSEMBLY_RULE_VERSION`) and `computeRecipeHash` (`where`, `metadataFields`, title field + `TITLE_RULE_VERSION`, withheld fields), SHA-256 over sorted-key JSON, pinned by `index-fingerprint.test.ts`. Every adapter call carries them (`AdapterContext.index`, `AdapterSearchOptions.index`). A complete reindex calls `beginBuild` before listing or writing (refusal ⇒ `ok: false`, nothing written) and `completeBuild` after the purge; a capped or dry-run walk calls neither.
- `@objectstack/spec/contracts`: `AdapterEmbeddingDescriptor.model/dimensions/variant`, `AdapterIndexExpectation`, `AdapterIndexStatus`, `IKnowledgeAdapter.indexStatus?/beginBuild?/completeBuild?`, `IEmbedder.model?`. All optional.
- Coded refusal through search (card comment, K7 rule 5): `KnowledgeService.search` keeps its signature (K9 rule 3); a source refused with a coded error (SCREAMING code + 4xx/5xx status) is dropped from the answer and logged by name; when no source answers, the refusal is thrown with its code/status and `refused` naming each source. `KnowledgeService.searchWithRefusals` returns `{ hits, refused }`; `search_knowledge` adds `refused` (sources the caller can see only) when non-empty.
- `knowledge-memory` is the reference: active + under-construction generations, switch at `completeBuild`, all flags true in its contract run.
- `embedder-openai`: `model` is public and reported.
- Contract suite: `implements` gains `indexStatus`, `builds`, `refusesOtherFingerprint`, `generations` with 9 cases (carry, fingerprint vs recipe-hash variation, build pair, status, search refusal, write refusal, through-service named/whole refusal, generation switch, rebuild after recipe change).
- `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED` registered in the error-code ledger under service-knowledge (the suite asserts it), knowledge-memory and knowledge-pgvector; generated references regenerated.

**CI (Tier H — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`)**: no existing step of `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` runs this package, so two steps are added after the runtime leg (build `@objectstack/knowledge-pgvector...`, then `vitest run live-postgres` with `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` and `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_DIALECT_MATRIX=1`, so a missing server is red, never a skip); `service-knowledge/src/testing.ts` joins the `temporal_live` merge-queue paths; the build-step count comment says five. The job's image is already pgvector's (#37095).

## Why

Card #37100 (ADR-0161 Execution row 8a): the open, self-hosted vector store, and the fingerprint that keeps two models' vectors from ever being ranked against each other.

## Open question

`searchWithRefusals` is a class method of `KnowledgeService`, not a member of `IKnowledgeService` (K9 rule 3 keeps `search`'s signature and return type). `search_knowledge` reads it structurally. Options: (A) keep it on the class (this PR); (B) add an optional `IKnowledgeService.searchWithRefusals?` member in a follow-up with its own K9 dated note. Recommendation A until a second consumer needs it.

## Deviations from the card

- `title` and `heading_path` columns beyond the card's list: hits return the document title, and `heading_path` is stored now so #37103's hit `headingPath` needs no schema change.
- The generation table also holds `recipe_hash` (K8 item 8 c).
- Store keying by package is #37304's (ruling 7168239918, Q1 = B); nothing built for it here.

## Tests

At head `4ab06c2f`, against a local PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector 0.6:

- `@objectstack/knowledge-pgvector` with `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_DIALECT_MATRIX=1`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 48 passed (48)` (contract suite 31, acceptance 8, real-driver reindex 2, unit 7). Without a URL: `7 passed | 41 skipped`; with the flag and no URL: 3 named failures (a skip turns red).
- `@objectstack/service-knowledge`: `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 291 passed (291)`. `@objectstack/knowledge-memory`: `43 passed`. `@objectstack/embedder-openai`: `31 passed`. `typecheck` green for all four.

<details><summary>Ablations (one-shot, restored by trap; 48 passed after restore)</summary>

- organization filter removed from the search `WHERE`: `6 failed | 42 passed` (the acceptance two-organization case and five contract organization cases, adapter and through the service).
- chunk-hash skip removed (every passage re-embedded): `1 failed | 47 passed` (the unchanged-passage case).
- search fingerprint check removed: `4 failed | 44 passed` (the two contract refusal cases and two acceptance cases).

</details>

<details><summary>Local derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 167 commands)</summary>

162 exit 0. One finding, `check-tenant-audit-census` (an untyped Map receiver in knowledge-memory), fixed in `b505ecc5` and green on re-run. Four NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite refusals, left to CI): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone), `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:published-readme-exports` (need every package built). CI's own reds on earlier heads (engine-double contract, llms.txt package count, test-source alias, system-context census row 46 re-keyed to `searchWithRefusals`, a test-file type error) are each fixed by a later commit.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

| Acceptance | Where |
|:--|:--|
| 3072-dim works | `acceptance.live-postgres.test.ts` — stores and ranks 3072-wide vectors (column type read back as `vector(3072)`) |
| two orgs never see each other's hits (adapter + service) | adapter: `acceptance…` two organizations case; service: contract suite organization cases under `isolated` / `group` |
| missing extension → readable error with SQL, boot continues | `not-ready.test.ts` (adapter refusal text, healthCheck false, plugin start resolves and warns, recovery after the SQL runs) |
| same content re-indexed → no embed call | `acceptance…` unchanged passage case (adapter) and second complete reindex case (service) |
| changed fingerprint → rebuild-needed error, old rows not served | contract suite search/write refusal cases; `acceptance…` changed embedding model case through the service |
| contract suite passes in CI on real PG | `contract.live-postgres.test.ts` in the new Temporal Conformance step |
| reindex over a real driver, mixed-case and numeric-looking ids (comment 7145881825) | `reindex-real-driver.live-postgres.test.ts` — 227 records over 3 walk pages, each indexed once, second reindex writes and embeds nothing |

## Verification

Two-minute check: `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=postgres://… pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-pgvector exec vitest run` against any PostgreSQL with pgvector available — expect `Test Files 4 passed`, `Tests 48 passed`.

Read first: `packages/plugins/knowledge-pgvector/src/pgvector-adapter.ts` (`upsert`, `search`, `ready`), `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts` (walk build calls, `searchWithRefusals`), `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the two new steps).

Overlap: #37335 (#37103) also edits `knowledge-service.ts`, `testing.ts`, `contract-stubs.test.ts`, `knowledge-memory/src/index.ts` and both docs pages; the second to land merges main.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
